notes: Operational data portfolio assessment for Liaoning consulting readiness. Categories describe business necessity, availability and current use depth; coverage_area links to audit-operational-coverage output when applicable.

categories.required_available: Required for normal consulting and currently usable when coverage/readiness gates pass.
categories.required_unavailable: Required for normal consulting but currently missing, under-covered or blocked by review/readiness.
categories.easy_but_underused: Relatively easy to obtain or already present, but the current product does not use it deeply enough.
categories.optional_enhancement: Useful for differentiation or future quality improvement, but not a launch blocker.
categories.not_for_formal_recommendation: May exist as raw/candidate/smoke data, but must not influence formal recommendation until reviewed.

domains.label: Liaoning admission plan
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Defines the school-major option universe and plan count for Liaoning families.

domains.label: Liaoning historical score/rank
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Must pass year-level reconciliation before it can be treated as official admission probability evidence.

domains.label: School identity/profile bridge
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Every Liaoning admission school code must map to a stable school identity or an explicit reviewed exception.

domains.label: School profile
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Every recommended school should have province, city, school type, tier and official profile evidence.

domains.label: School outcome evidence
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Recommended paths need employment, postgrad, keep-research or public-sector outcome evidence, or an explicit missing-data explanation.

domains.label: School location and campus address
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Required to explain distance, campus life, commute and local opportunity for families.

domains.label: Campus living score
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Required to compare daily life cost, surrounding services and family distance concerns.

domains.label: School-city-industry connection
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Required to answer whether the city can absorb graduates in the recommended major direction.

domains.label: Major outcome evidence
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Should distinguish direct professional roles, generalist roles, public-sector paths and postgrad paths.

domains.label: Holland to career bridge
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Only approved mappings may appear as formal career suggestions.

domains.label: City macro context
domains.normal_operation_requirement: Useful to improve city explanation, but should not replace school/major outcome evidence.
